# X1 Agent Skills

> A portable, authority-bounded skill for handling capital-call notices through
> X1's governed remote MCP service. It reviews and coordinates, but never moves
> money.

Preferred entry points:

- [Human overview and install](README.md)
- [Exact skill contract](plugins/x1-agent-skills/skills/handle-capital-call/SKILL.md)
- [Current public X1 boundary](plugins/x1-agent-skills/skills/handle-capital-call/references/current-x1-contract.md)
- [Synthetic evaluation guide](plugins/x1-agent-skills/skills/handle-capital-call/evals/README.md)
- [Compatibility matrix](compatibility.json)
- [Discovery prompt contract](discovery-prompts.json)
- [Security reporting](SECURITY.md)

Use this skill when a user wants to review, organize, resume, or coordinate a
capital-call notice through X1. Do not activate it for generic payment requests,
trading, wire instructions, unrelated document summaries, or requests to bypass
first-party confirmation.
